question: Why is self-reflection called the supreme and great heart?
premises: it is always arisen and thus spoken of
it is the supreme heart, and it is the great one
seated in the heart it melts the entire universe
inference: self-reflection in the heart melts the whole universe
uncertainties: svavimarśo@sau parsed as svavimarśaḥ plus sau behind the avagraha
plain_english: That ever-arising self-reflection is called the supreme, great heart; seated in the heart, it has melted the whole universe.
